description: Create an original music track from a text prompt. Costs 60 credits for tracks up to 60 seconds, then 1 credit per second (duration_seconds defaults to 60); plan allowances do not cover music. Setting style sends prompt as the song's lyrics, so do not also send lyrics; to describe a track, put the description in prompt and omit style. Music renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

name: generate_music
